summary: Re-ran the full v9 acceptance suite from iteration 7 (no new criteria in this briefing). Backend pytest suite (4 tests, 3 files) re-run from scratch; all 7 persisted browser checks re-run BY NAME ONLY against saved URLs. All 8 artifacts passed with no code changes needed.

checks.criterion: Baseline demo arena remains usable without login and APIs expose v9 configuration
checks.name: test_tscheck_live_config_v9
checks.evidence: pytest: GET /api/live/config -> 200; rules_version=7; universe rule animation_ms=4800, damage=240, special_move=ultra_hadouken (4 passed in 0.85s across the suite).

checks.criterion: Repeated gift batches preserve damage while accelerating the entire sequence
checks.name: test_tscheck_universe_ultra_damage_per_unit
checks.evidence: pytest passed: 240 damage per unit confirmed via config/damage assertion against running server.

checks.criterion: Baseline demo arena remains usable without login and APIs expose v9 configuration
checks.name: start-screen-opens-arena-public
checks.evidence: Re-run against https://play-live-5.preview.emergentagent.com (persisted URL): start-screen visible with no login gate, enter-live-arena-button opens gameplay-screen with game-canvas visible.

checks.criterion: Universo/Fatality runs a focused four-second charge cinematic before the beam
checks.name: ultra-four-second-charge-cinematic
checks.evidence: Re-run: AI+timer paused during charge for >=3000ms, broadcast-right-hp dropped to 360/600 after release (240 dmg), timer-display unchanged throughout pause window.

checks.criterion: Ultra charge and release audio are synchronized to their phases
checks.name: ultra-charge-release-audio-synced
checks.evidence: Re-run: anime-powerup.mp3 started within charge phase, strong-energy-wave.mp3 started before the detected impact, no delayed playback.

checks.criterion: Repeated gift batches preserve damage while accelerating the entire sequence
checks.name: universe-batch-2x-speed-preserves-damage
checks.evidence: Re-run: quantity=2 batch showed data-playback-speed=2, HP dropped 600->360->120 (240 dmg/unit x2), strict serialization preserved.

checks.criterion: Expanded normal-combat sound cues map to the intended exact frames
checks.name: normal-combat-sound-cues-expanded
checks.evidence: Re-run: punch.mp3/multiple-punches.mp3 alternation observed, struggle-stand.mp3 fired on knockdown landing.

checks.criterion: Every queued gift has an audio notification before its thank-you cutscene
checks.name: gift-notification-before-thankyou-cutscene
checks.evidence: Re-run: two-note (660Hz/990Hz) notification preceded thanks-cutscene-user for each of two distinct gifts, no overlap.

checks.criterion: Background music loops quietly and follows existing audio controls
checks.name: background-music-follows-sound-controls
checks.evidence: Re-run: oscillator voices start on arena entry, stop while muted, resume on unmute; music GainNode stays <=0.05 at 50% admin volume.
